items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: We were running by Ben Dale at that time. Ben Mulligan I meant to say.

ctx.x: Upstairs. Upstairs. There's a Pythian temple they call it sometime I think.

I go to work with Jack Kerrie and say, see y'all just quit too early. We went to my place where we used to go, we called Eagle Saloon. We were running by Ben Dale at that time. Ben Mulligan I meant to say. Say, I'm going to work now at the Winter Garden. And so I gets back with Jack Kerrie band and get Edmund Hall. We go back to Jack Kerrie and start playing. So I had quite a ball around the Winter Garden. All the best class musicians to come and sit in. Lorenzo Teal, Buddy Petit was the king, best young corner…
How did Buddy Petit play? Buddy Petit played the semi, just like Bunk.
